fusions.name: Drifting Ember
fusions.desc: Sends a slow, drifting ember that deals 3 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Boil
fusions.desc: Brings the water around you to a slow boil that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 10 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hot Spring Soak
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wintering Waters
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently. You have 10% fire resistance.
